units.text: The 2025 Nobel Chemistry laureates announced in Stockholm were Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar M. Yaghi; John Jumper is not listed among them.

citations.title: Press release: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2025 - NobelPrize.org

judgement.reason: The passages support the three named 2025 Chemistry laureates and do not list John Jumper among them, but they do not state that the announcement was made in Stockholm.

units.text: A press release from the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences explicitly states the 2025 Chemistry Prize was awarded to Kitagawa, Robson, and Yaghi for work on metal–organic frameworks.
